prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1324; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving my silver sedan in the right lane on the highway near Conroe, Texas, when I signaled and began moving left to change lanes. As I merged, a dark SUV in the left lane moved over into the same space and its right side struck the passenger side of my car. Both vehicles scraped along the guardrail before I could bring mine to a stop on the shoulder. I checked my mirrors and had seen no vehicle beside me just before I moved over. The other driver stayed at the scene, and we exchanged insurance information. My car's rear door and side panel are damaged. I felt a sharp pain in my lower back immediately after the impact and have been treated for a back strain since then. I am providing this statement to support my claim for vehicle repair and medical expenses.
